description: A unary partial function is computed by an arithmetic machine if and only if it is partial recursive under the corpus finite-arity closure rules.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.machine_equivalence (f : ℕ → Part ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MachinesAndComputationHistories.MachineComputable f ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Recursive fun v => f (List.Vector.get v 0)
